main_text.p: peratorem iftis confilijs fui propofiti compotem fore, noctu aufugit Caietam, deinde Beneuentum: poftremo 17. anno fui pontificatus in ecqui fui habitu Venetias uenit ubi in monafterio delitescens, ortulo praeficiebatur. Et poft aliquot menfes agnitus, habito fenatu, iuffu ducis Sebaftiani, maximo honore exceptus, pontificali pompa in templum D. Marci deducebatur. Nauclerus, Barnus, Funccius, & alij.

Imperator audiens Venetijs effe Papam, a Venetis poftulabat, ut fuum hoftem, hominem reipublicae perniciofum, fibi reftituerent. Quod cum Veneti denegarent, Othonem filium fuum cum armata claffe misit, ad repofcendum Alexandrum: interdicens tamen illi, ne quid armorum attentaret, priusquam ipse ueniret. Otho autem iuuenis prin-ceps, ferues & gloriae cupidus, neglecto patris man-dato, cum Venetis congrediebatur, uictus capiebatur, uinculisq; inclusus Venetias deducebatur. Creuerunt ex ea re cornua Alexandro, qui pacem inire cum Friderico noluit, nisi prius ueniret Venetias, accepturus ab eo praescriptas pacis conditiones. Vnde pater, mala fortunae filij cosulturus, pollicebatur se statuto tempore uenturum. Indicebatur illi dies[?]; adueniit, coueniebantq; de conditionibus pacis.

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment with its first letter cut off; kept as a fragment. "uictus" is printed with a ligature that could also read "uiftus"; the reading uictus is taken as likely. "Indicebatur illi dies" is partly doubtful at "dies". The catchword at the foot right is faint and uncertain. The paragraph breaks are set from the indents on the lines beginning "Imperator" and "Sed". Left margin marks are not printed text and are not transcribed.
